# 1b — Onboard the sources, verify them, explore them

Each source is registered in Zetaris (how: [01](01_use_case_and_sources.md)) and was queried live through MedTrace's own read-only Zetaris adapter. Every result below is the saved output of `scripts/zetaris_eval.py`.

## Hospital EMR (3 queries)

### How many patients and medicine lines does the EMR hold, by record kind?

```sql
SELECT record_kind, COUNT(DISTINCT source_patient_id) AS patients, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM medtrace.EMR GROUP BY record_kind ORDER BY lines DESC
```

| record_kind | patients | lines |
|---|---|---|
| admission_chart | 200 | 1326 |
| prior_discharge | 74 | 235 |

<sub>2 rows · 1,240 ms · run 2026-10-27T07:39:23+00:00 UTC via `app/adapters/zetaris.py (read-only)` · [`results/1b_emr_1.json`](results/1b_emr_1.json)</sub>

### Which medicines are charted most often on admission?

```sql
SELECT med_text AS medicine, COUNT(*) AS charted FROM medtrace.EMR WHERE record_kind = 'admission_chart' GROUP BY med_text ORDER BY charted DESC LIMIT 10
```

|---|---|
| rosuvastatin | 77 |
| amlodipine | 67 |
| esomeprazole | 58 |
| pantoprazole | 57 |
| paracetamol | 56 |

### Which chart notes document a medicine as withheld, and how often?

```sql

```

| withheld: hypotension | 44 |
| withheld: nil by mouth | 34 |
| withheld: AKI | 10 |
| withheld: bradycardia | 4 |
| withheld: contrast | 1 |

## GP (3 queries)

### How many patients does the GP silo cover, and what status are their medicines in?

```sql
SELECT status_text, COUNT(DISTINCT source_patient_id) AS patients, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM medtrace.GP GROUP BY status_text ORDER BY lines DESC
```

| status_text | patients | lines |
|---|---|---|
| active | 183 | 1364 |
| ceased | 104 | 163 |

<sub>2 rows · 936 ms · run 2026-10-27T07:39:26+00:00 UTC via `app/adapters/zetaris.py (read-only)` · [`results/1b_gp_1.json`](results/1b_gp_1.json)</sub>

### Which GP directions give no dose a pharmacist could confirm?

```sql
SELECT freq_text AS directions, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM medtrace.GP WHERE lower(freq_text) LIKE '%as directed%' OR lower(freq_text) LIKE '%per inr%' OR lower(freq_text) LIKE '%variable%' GROUP BY freq_text ORDER BY lines DESC
```

| directions | lines |
|---|---|
| as directed | 17 |
| variable per INR | 8 |
| as directed per INR | 2 |

<sub>3 rows · 934 ms · run 2026-10-27T07:39:27+00:00 UTC via `app/adapters/zetaris.py (read-only)` · [`results/1b_gp_2.json`](results/1b_gp_2.json)</sub>

### How old are the GP medication lists (year of last update)?

```sql
SELECT substring(doc_date, 7, 4) AS year_updated, COUNT(DISTINCT source_patient_id) AS patients FROM medtrace.GP GROUP BY substring(doc_date, 7, 4) ORDER BY year_updated
```

| year_updated | patients |
|---|---|
| 2025 | 27 |
| 2026 | 156 |
